decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several speakers focusing on brand reputation, user ratings, and portability. The Bose SoundLink Color II and the JBL Clip 3 were the strongest contenders. Although the Bose offers premium sound, the JBL Clip 3 has an exceptionally high rating (4.7) across a massive number of reviews (over 68,000) and is more budget-friendly. I also considered the renewed JBL Flip 5, but preferred a new product given some review complaints about battery longevity in the refurbished unit. The JBL Clip 3's integrated carabiner and waterproof rating make it the most versatile and reliable choice for my needs.
